g.text: Figure 4 (revises 2.2 Figure 4): Create an expense with a split preview (FR 2.1 to 2.6, 2.9, 3.1 to 3.7; D2, D3)
[each change to total, payer, participants, split method or a share input]
CHANGED: recomputePreview() parses each share input itself
(a bad entry is flagged on its own row), and checkPercentages /
checkSum run only once every selected participant has a valid
entry; an equal split needs no checkSum
enter title, pick category, note; tap Save
CHANGED: save() checks the title and total, re-runs the
preview and stops unless the split is valid, all before
the expense is built (2.2 checked the split only after
[title or total missing, fewer than two participants, or split not valid]
error shown on the field (for the split: a message
and a scroll to the preview), nothing saved

messages and notes marked NEW or CHANGED are departures from Project 2.2; plain = unchanged.
